title: Sum of complete local sections is complete
statement: For the complete-element predicate [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-complete-element] on a small ringed site, if f and g are complete for K on U, then f+g is complete for K on U. No boundedness or nonzero hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 0997 and 0998, original proof steps 3 and 4; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 08JC.

proof.text: With h=f+g, the multiplication result gives vanishing of RHom from L(h*f), L(h*g), and L((h*f)*g).

source.place: Tags 0997 and 0998, original proof steps 3 and 4; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 08JC.

proof.text: Use the binary Cech short exact row and its degree-zero distinguished triangle. Additivity of RHom gives zero on the binary biproduct, explicitly using the identity as the sum of the two projection-inclusion composites.

source.place: Tags 0997 and 0998, original proof steps 3 and 4; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 08JC.

proof.text: Apply contravariant triangulated RHom to the opposite distinguished triangle. The zero-object criterion for distinguished triangles then forces RHom from L(h) to be zero.

theorem ringedSite_completeElement_add
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))]
    [∀ U : C, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R).over U))]
    (K : DerivedCategory (ringedSiteModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))) (U : C) (f g : R.obj.obj (op U))
    (hf : IsRingedSiteCompleteElement J R K U f)
    (hg : IsRingedSiteCompleteElement J R K U g) :
    IsRingedSiteCompleteElement J R K U (f + g)
